title: Rabbi Chanan

paragraphs: In [Chullin 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.5b.8): Rabbi Chanan transmitted a teaching from Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. In [Sanhedrin 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.8a.6): “Rabbi Chanan said — and some say Rabbi Shabtai” (referring to Rabbi Elazar’s words). In [Berakhot 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.10b.1): “Rabbi Chanan said: Even if the master of dreams tells a person that tomorrow he will die, he should not refrain from [praying for] mercy” (referring to the words of Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Elazar).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin continues the chain to Bar Kappara. The Sanhedrin text gives Chanan and Shabtai as alternatives, and the linked Berakhot has Chanan give the advice about a troubling dream.
